name: – After § 27 – Am 2
title: Resolution on the devastating floods in central and eastern Europe, the loss of lives and the EU’s preparedness to act on such disasters exacerbated by climate change
part_text: 27a. Underlines that solidarity is key to emergency responses and preparedness; believes that the EU should enhance its support to the developing countries most affected by the impacts of climate change as they are not as prepared for extreme weather events as the EU and thus suffer greater losses and damage;
